patchNotes:
## v0.1.10 - Smarter Heroes, Better Loot

**Bug Fixes**
- AI heroes no longer get stuck bouncing between two tiles near doors and corridors
- Team leaders no longer freeze permanently mid-dungeon due to a suppression deadlock
- When your leader dies in PvPvE, the rest of the team now properly promotes a new leader instead of standing around forever
- Heroes now correctly pass gear to teammates who can actually use it (no more swords going to mages)
- Picked-up loot that is better for a teammate now gets traded and equipped automatically instead of sitting in someone's bag unused

**New Features**
- Dev Overlay: Equipment and Inventory Inspector - click any unit to see their full gear, inventory, item stats, rarity, and set bonuses in real time
- Followers now wander and explore on their own when their leader is idle for too long, keeping the team active
- Patrol system now guides heroes toward unexplored rooms instead of wandering randomly
- All visited-tile penalties reset when the patrol system runs out of new places to go, so heroes never get permanently stuck

**Dev Tools**
- New PvPvE batch tool flag (--equipment-report) for tracking all AI loot management across matches
